Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. trace.raw_text: {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00') AND business_date <= '2026-10-23'), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM eligible), active AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), inv AS (SELECT * FROM active WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'), totals AS (SELECT invoice_id, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='payment' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='credit' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS credited, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='hold' AND status NOT IN ('release','void') THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS held FROM active WHERE kind IN ('payment','credit','hold') GROUP BY invoice_id), calc AS (SELECT i.event_key, MAX(0, MAX(0, i.amount_minor-COALESCE(t.paid,0)-COALESCE(t.credited,0))-COALESCE(t.held,0)) * (10000-CASE WHEN te.event_key IS NULL OR '2026-10-23' > te.discount_until THEN 0 ELSE te.discount_bps END) AS discounted_num, fx.fx_num, fx.fx_den FROM inv i LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.invoice_id=i.event_key LEFT JOIN active te ON te.kind='terms' AND te.terms_code=i.terms_code AND te.business_date=(SELECT MAX(te2.business_date) FROM active te2 WHERE te2.kind='terms' AND te2.terms_code=i.terms_code AND te2.business_date <= i.business_date) LEFT JOIN active fx ON fx.kind='fx' AND fx.currency=i.currency AND fx.business_date=(SELECT MAX(fx2.business_date) FROM active fx2 WHERE fx2.kind='fx' AND fx2.currency=i.currency AND fx2.business_date <= i.business_date)) SELECT SUM(CAST((discounted_num*fx_num*2 + 10000*fx_den)/(2*10000*fx_den) AS INTEGER)) AS usd_cents FROM calc WHERE fx_den > 0 AND fx_num IS NOT NULL"}}
